definitions.gloss: long-cherished wish; longtime ambition; heartfelt desire
definitions.explanation: A wish or goal that one has held for a very long time, often implying years of effort or patience toward its fulfillment.

examples.japanese: {宿願|しゅくがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
{宿願|しゅくがん}だった⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦{出場|しゅつじょう}→出場：03223_shutsujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついに⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My long-held dream of competing in the Olympics finally came true.

examples.japanese: {三十年|さんじゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる{宿願|しゅくがん}であった{和平|わへい}⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{締結|ていけつ}→締結：13870_teiketsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}→達成：04816_tassei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The signing of the peace treaty, a goal pursued for thirty years, was achieved.

notes:
A compound of {宿|しゅく} (long-standing) and {願|がん} (wish/prayer). A literary, elevated word that emphasizes the depth and duration of a desire. Often used in formal speeches, news articles, and historical writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宿願|しゅくがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to fulfill a long-cherished wish
- {宿願|しゅくがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{叶|かな}う→叶う：05303_kanau⟧: a long-held wish comes true
- {宿願|しゅくがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}する→達成する：22183_tasseisuru⟧: to achieve a long-held goal
- {宿願|しゅくがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧: realization of a long-cherished wish

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悲願|ひがん}→悲願：21839_higan⟧: earnest wish — similar formality but adds a nuance of desperate longing or repeated failed attempts
- ⟦{念願|ねんがん}→念願：17955_nengan⟧: long-cherished desire — very close in meaning; slightly more common in everyday usage
- ⟦{願望|がんぼう}→願望：05085_ganbou⟧: desire, aspiration — more general and less literary
